In cross II, a vestigial-winged (recessive) female mated with a normal-winged (dominant) male, producing exclusively normal-winged females and exclusively vestigial-winged males.
因為雄性子代唯一的 X 染色體必定來自雌性親代，這解釋了為何所有雄性子代均表現出與母親完全相同的隱性性狀。
